tips.text: Run Helene on Saturn with a Nekros and boosters for Orokin Cells and Nano Spores in one sitting; Rubedo needs a separate Phobos or Europa run.
Farm the 65,000 credits early on a fresh account; Dark Sector nodes such as Seminii on Ceres are the usual pick.
Players call the Vectis a trivial early-game build; the 24-hour timer is the only wait.
